q1.explanationZh: 第一段说画家不是人，而是动物（they are animals）。

evidence.quote: some amazing artists are not people—they are animals!

q2.explanationZh: 卖画得到的钱用来照顾动物和它们的家，所以拍卖是为了筹钱帮助动物。

evidence.quote: The money would help take care of the animals and their homes.

q3.explanationZh: 文章说钱会用来照顾动物和它们的家。

evidence.quote: The money would help take care of the animals and their homes.

q4.explanationZh: 最后一句说看到动物有创意又开心很有趣，所以是让它们玩得开心、发挥创造力。

evidence.quote: it’s fun to see animals being creative and happy
